[Bug]: New Topic, Task, or Route Not Redirecting to Newly Created Item Page

  • Bug Resolution Plan
    • 1. Verify Item Creation Success
      •   - Ensure that the item (Topic, Task, or Route) has been successfully created in the system.
    • 2. Return Unique Identifier
      •   - If the creation is successful, include the unique identifier (`uniqueId`) of the newly created item in the response.
    • 3. Redirect to Newly Created Item Page
      •   - Upon receiving the response with the `uniqueId`, automatically route the user to the newly created item's page.
    • 4. Handle Errors Gracefully
      •   - If the creation process fails, display a clear error message to the user.
      •   - Prevent any redirection from the creation/update form, allowing the user to address the issue before proceeding.
    • 5. Testing and Validation
      •   - Conduct thorough testing to ensure that the routing behavior works as expected for all item types (Topic, Task, Route).
      •   - Validate that error handling is robust and provides meaningful feedback to the user.
    • By following this plan, we ensure a seamless user experience where newly created items are immediately accessible, and any errors are communicated effectively.

**Expectation for next major release 1.1.0**

- **Business Logic**
    - The project will contain all personal and professional project details, including:
        - Project name
        - Repository location
        - Unique slug (derived from the repository location)
        - Tech stacks
        - Purpose of the project
        - All version details (a multiline string)
        - Next major release and its target (a multiline string)
        - Current version and its target (a multiline string)

            - Company name
            - Other relevant details
    - Secure API
        - Secured by JWT tokens
        - Role-based access control
            - Admins can edit data
            - Readers can view data
        - Granular authority for the Reader role:
            - Readers can access one or more project details based on configuration
    - Users with either admin or reader roles can log into the application:
        - Since the user base is currently small, in-memory user details are preferred for now
        - Later, a centralized approach for managing user details will be implemented

            - Use the UI to update/view their details
            - Use the API with a valid JWT token
    - Admins can:
        - Create new user accounts
        - View user details
        - Reset passwords

    - API to perform CRUD operations for projects

name: **[Planned]**: [`Software Architecture change`]: [`For better re-usability of code and less code redundancy`]: Simplify Field Addition Process for Entity and UI Integration

descriptions.content:
# Title: **[Planned]**: [`Software Architecture change`]: [`For better re-usability of code and less code redundancy`]: Simplify Field Addition Process for Entity and UI Integration

## **Current Process for Adding a New Field to an Entity in MongoDocument (Java) or Model (ExpressJS):**

Whenever a new field is added to an entity (whether it's a MongoDocument in a Java-based project or a model in an ExpressJS application), the following steps need to be followed to ensure full integration from the backend to the frontend:

1. **Add the New Field to the DTO**:
   - Update the **DTO (Data Transfer Object)** to include the new field for sending and receiving data between the backend and frontend.

2. **Update Backend Layers**:
   - **Controller**: Modify the controller to handle the new field during CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations.
   - **Service Layer**: Update the service layer methods to manage the new field's logic for business operations.
   - **Validation Layer**: Add validation rules to ensure the field's data integrity (e.g., required, format checks, etc.).
   - **Database Layer**: Ensure the field is correctly mapped in the database (MongoDocument/Schema).

3. **Frontend Form Adjustments**:
   - Update the relevant **forms** in the UI to include inputs for the newly added field.
   - Ensure the field appears in the correct section of the user interface where data input is required.

4. **Frontend Validation and Sanitization**:
   - Implement validation logic on the frontend to check the new field's value (e.g., required, type checks).
   - Add **sanitization** and **transformation** logic where necessary, ensuring that the field data is properly prepared before submission.

5. **Rendering Data in the UI**:
   - Modify the UI to **display** the newly added field's data in relevant views (e.g., tables, detail pages, etc.).
   - Ensure the field is formatted correctly when rendered.

6. **Testing**:
   - Ensure the field passes unit tests and integration tests across the backend and frontend.
   - Validate the correct display and functionality of the new field in end-to-end tests.

7. **API Documentation**:
   - Update API documentation (if applicable) to reflect the changes made with the new field in DTOs and endpoints.

By following these steps, the newly added field will be fully integrated into the system, ensuring consistent behavior across all layers from the database to the user interface.


## Acceptance Criteria 
As a software architect, I want to explore and simplify above process

# Task: add `lastRevisedOn` field in [**`InterviewQuestion Schema`**](https://github.com/sameer05515/react-projects/blob/master/learn-react/TweetApp/backend/src/routes/InterviewMgmt.v2.model.js) in [**TweetApp backend**](https://github.com/sameer05515/react-projects/tree/master/learn-react/TweetApp/backend) code

## Steps 
- [**Developed, Integration in progress**]: add `lastRevisedOn` field in `InterviewQuestion Schema`
- [**Developed, Integration in progress**]: initially fetch and check default value coming in get-question-details rest request
  - [**Developed, Integration in progress**]: If `lastRevisedOn` not found in details , default message `Question never revised` will be shown in `QuestionCard`
  - We should make the defalt message text in red color
- create new route to partial update `lastRevisedOn` field of InterviewQuestion for given question id
  - try to implement validators in backend code
  - attach api in frontend code using `useConsolidated` hook and `useInterviewMgmtApis` hook
